name: Boostsite – AI Content Generator
author: boostsite

sections.description:
Boostsite is an AI content writer that automatically generates and publishes search-optimized blog posts for your website. It’s built for publishers, WooCommerce store owners, SEO agencies, and any website owner who wants to stay active online without spending hours creating content.

Key Features

  • Fully Automated Content Creation
    Just set your topic, schedule, and optional keywords. Boostsite takes care of the rest: research, writing, images, SEO, and publishing.

  • SEO Best Practices Built-In
    All content follows the latest search engine standards. No SEO skills needed.

  • Smart Keyword Integration
    Add your keywords – Boostsite blends them into your content naturally, boosting your chances of ranking.

  • Dynamic Image Sourcing
    Boostsite finds high-quality, royalty-free images that match your topic and look great on your site.

  • Flexible Publishing Options
    Choose between full auto-publish or review mode if you prefer to approve drafts before they go live.

  • Multilingual & Localization Ready
    Create content in any language with built-in translation and local SEO support.

Why Use Boostsite?

Save Time & Resources
Skip hours of research, writing, and editing. Focus on what grows your business.

Consistent, High-Quality Content
Keep your blog active with content that fits your brand voice and SEO goals.

Scalable Growth
Whether you need 2 posts a week or 20 a day, Boostsite keeps up — ideal for blogs, product pages, knowledge hubs, or monetized sites that earn through ads.

Getting Started

  1. Install the Boostsite – AI Content Generator plugin from the WordPress Marketplace
  2. Set your schedule, SEO preferences, and content plan
  3. Sit back — Boostsite will write, optimize, and publish for you

Turn your WordPress site into a content machine with Boostsite – the AI content writer for SEO-focused brands, agencies, and busy creators.

Download now and grow without content bottlenecks.

Developer Information

Source Code

The source code for all compiled JavaScript and CSS files is included in this plugin under the src/ directory.

Build Process

This plugin uses Laravel Mix with Vue.js and TypeScript. To build from source:

  1. Install Node.js (>= 18)
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies
  3. Run npm run production to build for production
  4. Run npm run development for development builds

Build Tools Used

  • Laravel Mix (webpack wrapper)
  • Vue.js 3 with TypeScript
  • Tailwind CSS
  • PostCSS with autoprefixer

File Structure

  • Source files: src/ directory
  • Build configuration: webpack.mix.js
  • Compiled output: public/js/ and public/css/

All source code is included with the plugin distribution for transparency and compliance with WordPress.org guidelines.

External services

This plugin connects to Boostsite’s AI content generation API (https://api.boostsite.com) to automatically create and publish blog articles for your website.

It sends your website URL, content topics, and scheduling preferences when you create content schedules. User email and site data are sent during account setup and authentication.

This service is provided by Boostsite: Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Installing “WordPress Plugin Template” can be done either by searching for “WordPress Plugin Template” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload’ screen in your WordPress dashboard
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
